agyos_skill.intent: Design task-local harnesses, eval gates, and reusable skill extraction for Claude dynamic workflow mode and other adaptive agent harnesses. Use when building a task-local harness, adding eval gates, or extracting a reusable skill from ad-hoc work.
agyos_skill.instructions: Use this skill when a coding agent can generate or adapt a task-local harness instead of only following a static command flow. The goal is to turn dynamic workflow mode into a disciplined system: temporary harnesses for one-off work, shared skill extraction for repeated work, and observable control pane checkpoints for teams. - The user mentions dynamic workflows, custom harnesses, harness-per-task, adaptive workflows, or Claude Code dynamic workflow mode. - A task needs a custom loop, evaluator, crawler, fixture generator, watcher, or local dashboard. - Multiple agents need the same repeatable process but the process is not yet captured as a shared skill. - A workflow needs durable handoff artifacts, eval evidence, or operator approval before merge. Dynamic workflow mode should produce a task-local harness only when the harness is cheaper and safer than manually driving the same steps. The harness must have: - **Objective**: the outcome it owns and the outcome it explicitly does not own. - **Inputs**: files, URLs, prompts, data sources, credentials policy, and user-provided constraints. - **Outputs**: commits, reports, screenshots, status files, or control pane snapshots. - **Eval**: at least one pass/fail check tied to the task, not only "it ran". - **Handoff**: a short artifact that tells the next operator what happened, what is blocked, and how to resume. Make two independent parts of `Inputs` explicit before discovery or execution: - **Action-to-tool bindings**: which tool may read, write, or publish for each operation. A tool being available does not authorize it for another action. - **Entity scope**: selected account, project, workspace, period, and exclusions, separately from search filters such as a shared payee, label, or name. Carry both into executor instructions and the handoff. Apply the entity boundary to discovery, batch preparation, and remaining-work reports, not only to writes. If a required boundary is ambiguous, hold that group and ask for the missing boundary. Continue independent work whose scope is already clear. If the selected tool lacks an operation, report the limitation and hold that operation rather than silently substituting another tool. Only explicit later authorization from the controlling user or an explicitly authorized human operator may change the authorized actions, entities, phase, or action-to-tool binding for that scoped operation. Record each binding change as the previous
